department: Graduate School WIMEK (Environment and Climate Research)

deadline.value: Each PhD position has its own closing date. The example quoted (atmospheric sciences, meteorology) closes 30 October 2026.

also.quote: apply for an already funded position via a vacancy

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: The vacancy asks applicants to contact the assistant professor supervising the position for more information.
supervisor.quote: please contact Laura Suarez-Gutierrez, Assistant Professor for Meteorology, Email: laura.suarez@wur.nl

funding.value: The page says funding must be guaranteed before a PhD can start, which is a condition of admission, not a funding rule.

entry_route.value: Applicants must hold a master's degree comparable to a Dutch master's degree.
entry_route.quote: The candidate must hold a master’s degree that is comparable to a Dutch master’s degree

notes: WIMEK's PhD scope is environmental change, its impact on quality of life and sustainability, and climate research (graduate schools page). The vacancy quoted is in meteorology and is the nearest official example, not a WIMEK-wide rule. The vacancy page shows 'Apply before 31-10-2026' beside the text 'up to and including 30 October 2026'; the text date is quoted.
